subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be documentation/help for the current pi-tui behavior only, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already supports inline newline insertion through pi-tui, but configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter behavior would add public TUI configuration or CLI/API surface under a repository policy that sets a high bar for new config options.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with docs and tests for default and customized send/newline behavior.

options.title: Split Broader Composer Work
options.body: Keep this issue to TUI inline docs/help and route WebChat shortcuts, external editor handoff, and vi-mode work to their existing separate trackers.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this issue and have the strongest recent TUI docs, command, CLI, and wrapper history signal.
